title: Paridrome Partout
author: Hempelson Tamsova
rules:
Saprelotte, What a mess!

That is Part two of my Paridrome puzzles

I just wanted to draw

two lines

but my pencil slipped

now there're paridromes all over the place.

C'est la vie, I guess...

Normal Sudoku rules apply.

Paridrome:

Any Line in the grid reads the same in both directions. In addition adjacent digits along such a line are non-consecutive and do not share the same parity (one will be odd, one will be even). Every blue line’s central digit holds the same parity (X), and every light orange line’s central digit holds the same parity (Y), where X and Y have opposite parities.

An inequality symbol between two cells points towards the smaller digit.

(Note: R5C8 is occupied by two different lines, yet for visibility reasons they don't meet in the center of that cell)

solve with SudokuPad

P.s.

I was about to give this puzzle a 5* difficulty estimation, because I find it slightly if not fairly harder than the first paridrome puzzle, which already got 4*, but I wasn't quite sure if it fits into this category.
solutionCode: The diagonal (top left corner to bottom right, 9 digits, no spaces in between)
